recipes.title: Herby chickpea salad
recipes.description: A crisp, lemony lunch with plenty of herbs.
recipes.ingredients:
1 tin chickpeas, drained
Half a cucumber
1 lemon
Fresh mint and parsley
2 tbsp olive oil
recipes.instructions:
Chop the cucumber and herbs.
Mix with chickpeas, olive oil, and lemon juice.
Season and serve.

recipes.title: Mushroom butter rice
recipes.description: A cosy pan of rice with golden mushrooms.
recipes.ingredients:
200g mushrooms
150g rice
1 tbsp butter
1 clove garlic
350ml vegetable stock
recipes.instructions:
Slice the mushrooms and fry in butter until golden.
Add garlic and rice, then stir in the stock.
Cover and simmer gently until the rice is tender.
